mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, leading to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in high-UNRATE periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in real economic output, reducing corporate profitability and triggering negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the average return in low-INDPRO periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in residential construction starts (HOUST) above 650,000 units, combined with rising real personal consumption (RSAFS), signals strong underlying demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 650.0 and RSAFS > 360000.0 fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPIAUCSL above 217.5 over two consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, increasing the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 217.5, or the average return in high-CPIAUCSL periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 130,000 thousand, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9.5%), signals a labor market collapse, increasing recession risk and triggering negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS < 130000.0 and UNRATE > 9.5% fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 13,200 billion, observed over a 4-quarter window, indicates a deepening economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth prospects and leading to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 13200.0, or the average return in low-GDPC1 periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
